# University of Waterloo

> Public research university in Ontario, Canada, known for co-operative education, research, and interdisciplinary academic programs.

The University of Waterloo website spans admissions, academics, faculties, co-op and careers, research, student services, libraries, news, events, and institutional information. This guide highlights the most useful pages for understanding programs, policies, support services, and campus operations.

## Admissions and Future Students
- [Future Students](https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/): Main undergraduate recruitment hub with programs, admissions, co-op, and student life information.
- [Programs](https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/programs): Browse undergraduate programs, majors, and academic options across all faculties.
- [How to Apply](https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/admissions/how-to-apply): Step-by-step undergraduate application process for domestic and international applicants.
- [Admission Requirements](https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/admissions/admission-requirements): Faculty- and program-specific admission requirements for applicants from different education systems.
- [Tuition and Fees](https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/financing/tuition): Undergraduate tuition information and fee estimates for planning studies.
- [Scholarships and Bursaries](https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/financing/scholarships): Entrance scholarships, awards, and financial aid opportunities for future students.
- [Graduate Studies and Postdoctoral Affairs](https://uwaterloo.ca/graduate-studies-postdoctoral-affairs/): Central hub for graduate programs, admissions, funding, and postdoctoral information.
- [Graduate Programs](https://uwaterloo.ca/graduate-studies-postdoctoral-affairs/future-students/programs): Search graduate degrees, diplomas, and collaborative programs offered at Waterloo.

## Academics and Faculties
- [Faculties and Academics](https://uwaterloo.ca/faculties-academics): Overview of faculties, schools, academic units, and educational structure.
- [Faculty of Arts](https://uwaterloo.ca/arts/): Programs, departments, research, and student resources in the humanities and social sciences.
- [Faculty of Engineering](https://uwaterloo.ca/engineering/): Engineering programs, departments, research initiatives, and student information.
- [Faculty of Environment](https://uwaterloo.ca/environment/): Academic programs and research focused on sustainability, planning, and environmental systems.
- [Faculty of Health](https://uwaterloo.ca/health/): Health-related programs, research, and student opportunities across multiple disciplines.
- [Faculty of Mathematics](https://uwaterloo.ca/math/): Mathematics, computer science, statistics, and related academic offerings.
- [Faculty of Science](https://uwaterloo.ca/science/): Science departments, undergraduate and graduate programs, and research resources.
- [University Colleges](https://uwaterloo.ca/university-colleges/): Information on Waterloo’s affiliated and federated university colleges.

## Co-op, Careers, and Employers
- [Co-operative and Experiential Education](https://uwaterloo.ca/co-operative-education/): Overview of Waterloo’s co-op system, work-integrated learning, and employer partnerships.
- [Future Students Co-op](https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/co-op): Explains how co-op works, sample sequences, earnings, and career benefits.
- [Hire Waterloo](https://uwaterloo.ca/hire/): Employer portal for recruiting Waterloo co-op students and graduates.
- [How to Hire](https://uwaterloo.ca/hire/how-to-hire): Employer guidance for posting jobs, interviewing, and hiring Waterloo talent.
- [WaterlooWorks](https://uwaterloo.ca/waterlooworks/): Employment and career platform for students, alumni, and employers.
- [Centre for Career Development](https://uwaterloo.ca/career-development/): Career advising, workshops, resources, and job search support for students.
- [Work-Learn Institute](https://uwaterloo.ca/work-learn-institute/): Research institute focused on work-integrated learning and the future of work.

## Research and Innovation
- [Research](https://uwaterloo.ca/research/): Central research portal covering institutes, funding, partnerships, and impact.
- [Office of Research](https://uwaterloo.ca/research/office-research): Research administration, ethics, grants, and institutional support services.
- [Research Institutes and Centres](https://uwaterloo.ca/research/research-institutes-centres): Directory of interdisciplinary institutes, centres, and research groups.
- [Waterloo Ventures](https://uwaterloo.ca/waterloo-ventures/): Entrepreneurship and commercialization support for founders and startups.
- [Library Research Support](https://uwaterloo.ca/library/services/research-support): Library services for data, publishing, systematic reviews, and scholarly communication.
- [Graduate Studies and Research](https://uwaterloo.ca/graduate-studies-postdoctoral-affairs/current-students): Policies, milestones, and resources for graduate researchers.

## Current Students and Student Services
- [Current Students](https://uwaterloo.ca/current-students/): Central student portal for academics, finances, housing, and campus services.
- [The Centre](https://uwaterloo.ca/the-centre/): Registrar-related support for records, enrolment, documents, and student accounts.
- [Student Success Office](https://uwaterloo.ca/student-success/): Academic development, transition support, and student success programming.
- [Campus Wellness](https://uwaterloo.ca/campus-wellness/): Health, counselling, medical, and wellness services for students.
- [AccessAbility Services](https://uwaterloo.ca/accessability-services/): Academic accommodations and accessibility support for students with disabilities.
- [Housing](https://uwaterloo.ca/campus-housing/): Residence options, applications, move-in details, and housing support.
- [WatSAFE](https://uwaterloo.ca/watsafe/): Campus safety resources, emergency procedures, and personal safety programs.
- [Food Services](https://uwaterloo.ca/food-services/): Dining locations, meal plans, hours, and campus food information.

## Academics, Calendars, and Policies
- [Undergraduate Calendar](https://uwaterloo.ca/academic-calendar/undergraduate-studies/catalog#/home): Official undergraduate academic regulations, programs, and course requirements.
- [Graduate Studies Academic Calendar](https://uwaterloo.ca/academic-calendar/graduate-studies/catalog#/home): Official graduate regulations, degree requirements, and academic policies.
- [Important Dates](https://uwaterloo.ca/registrar/important-dates/calendar): Key academic deadlines for terms, enrolment, fees, and exams.
- [Course Selection Offerings](https://classes.uwaterloo.ca/): Search class schedules, course offerings, and term availability.
- [Quest](https://uwaterloo.ca/quest/): Student information system for enrolment, finances, grades, and records.
- [Registrar’s Office](https://uwaterloo.ca/registrar/): Academic records, enrolment services, forms, and institutional scheduling information.
- [Policies and Procedures](https://uwaterloo.ca/secretariat/policies-procedures-guidelines): University-wide policies, procedures, and governance guidelines.

## Library and Learning Resources
- [Library](https://uwaterloo.ca/library/): Main library site with collections, services, spaces, and research help.
- [Omni](https://uwaterloo.ca/library/omni): Discovery search for books, articles, journals, and other library materials.
- [Library Services](https://uwaterloo.ca/library/services): Borrowing, consultations, course reserves, and academic support services.
- [Subject Guides](https://subjectguides.uwaterloo.ca/): Discipline-specific research guides curated by Waterloo librarians.
- [Writing and Communication Centre](https://uwaterloo.ca/writing-and-communication-centre/): Writing, presentations, communication support, and graduate writing resources.
- [Centre for Teaching Excellence](https://uwaterloo.ca/centre-for-teaching-excellence/): Teaching support, learning resources, and pedagogical development.

## Campus Life, News, and Events
- [News](https://uwaterloo.ca/news/): University news, research stories, announcements, and institutional updates.
- [Events](https://uwaterloo.ca/events/): Central calendar for academic, cultural, and community events across campus.
- [Waterloo Magazine](https://uwaterloo.ca/waterloo-magazine/): Feature stories about alumni, research, and university impact.
- [Athletics and Recreation](https://uwaterloo.ca/athletics-recreation/): Varsity sports, recreation programs, facilities, and fitness services.
- [Student Experience and Housing](https://uwaterloo.ca/student-experience-housing/): Campus life programming, orientation, leadership, and residence experience.
- [Sustainability Office](https://uwaterloo.ca/sustainability/): Campus sustainability initiatives, reporting, and engagement opportunities.

## About, Governance, and Administration
- [About Waterloo](https://uwaterloo.ca/about/): Institutional overview, history, mission, and strategic priorities.
- [Leadership and Governance](https://uwaterloo.ca/about/leadership-and-governance): University leadership structure, governing bodies, and administrative organization.
- [Office of the President](https://uwaterloo.ca/president/): Presidential priorities, messages, and institutional leadership information.
- [Secretariat](https://uwaterloo.ca/secretariat/): Governance support, Senate and Board materials, and policy administration.
- [Institutional Analysis and Planning](https://uwaterloo.ca/institutional-analysis-planning/): Official data, reports, enrolment statistics, and planning resources.
- [Human Resources](https://uwaterloo.ca/human-resources/): Employment, benefits, workplace policies, and staff resources.
- [Careers at Waterloo](https://uwaterloo.ca/human-resources/careers): Faculty and staff job opportunities and employment information.

## Alumni, Giving, and Community
- [Alumni](https://uwaterloo.ca/alumni/): Alumni services, benefits, events, and ways to stay connected.
- [Support Waterloo](https://uwaterloo.ca/support/): Giving opportunities, campaigns, and donor information.
- [Advancement](https://uwaterloo.ca/advancement/): University advancement initiatives spanning alumni relations and philanthropy.
- [Community Relations and Events](https://uwaterloo.ca/community-relations-events/): Public engagement, community partnerships, and institutional events support.
- [United Way Campaign](https://uwaterloo.ca/united-way/): University community fundraising and volunteer engagement for United Way.

## International and Global Engagement
- [International Experience](https://uwaterloo.ca/international-experience/): Study abroad, exchanges, and global learning opportunities for students.
- [Waterloo International](https://uwaterloo.ca/waterloo-international/): International partnerships, mobility, and global engagement initiatives.
- [International Student Guide](https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/international-students): Admissions and transition information for international applicants.
- [Immigration Consulting](https://uwaterloo.ca/student-success/international-student-resources/immigration-consulting): Immigration advising and permit guidance for international students.
- [Exchange and Study Abroad](https://uwaterloo.ca/international-experience/students/outbound): Outbound exchange and study abroad planning resources.
